title: MIN-4 tie-break reconciliation: area_quantized (pre-C010b) -> dom_order (C011/C012)
instruction_compliance: authority re-read fresh at bc0b7a0 in this worktree before any code change, per explicit instruction not to implement from memory of a prior session.

authority_read.a2_section_read: §1.13 Candidate 수준 어휘 -- dom_order 값 도메인 (정본)

execution_authority_line_129_claim_check.finding: grep for 'dom_order' and '정렬' across the current EXECUTION_AUTHORITY.md at bc0b7a0 returns zero matches -- this document does not currently contain a sort/ordering clause for dom_order at line 129 or anywhere else. Line 129 in the current file falls inside the '§5 SUPERSEDED_FOR_SCOPE / OPERATIONAL_GUARDS_INHERITED' section (inherited operational guards list), unrelated to MIN-4/dom_order. This is reported as-is rather than force-fitting a citation -- the authoritative sort clause actually lives in A1 §2.6 (규칙 MIN-4, line ~358-460) and A2 §1.13, both of which were read in full and are the basis for everything below.

confirmed_current_definition.area_css_px2_excluded_from_tie_break: explicitly and permanently -- 'area_css_px2를 tie-break 키에서 뺀다', quantization approach abandoned entirely at V2-C010b after two prior quantization schemes (floor 1px^2, round 16px^2) were both shown to not neutralize sub-pixel jitter
confirmed_current_definition.dom_order_type: Int64, >=0, 0-based, monotonic increasing within one document's candidate enumeration
confirmed_current_definition.dom_order_null_semantics: NOT ALLOWED -- structural value, no concept of missing observation. If NULL is observed it is a PROBE DEFECT, handled as MEASUREMENT_FAILED, not a legitimate NULL
confirmed_current_definition.dom_order_uniqueness: unique within (observation_id, document) -- iframe/frame boundaries restart numbering at 0, so selector (3rd tie-break key) is retained to disambiguate cross-document collisions
confirmed_current_definition.freeze_output_requirement: A1 §2.6/§8 -- frozen path output must store at minimum: step_index, selector, dom_order, expected state id, plus path_sha256 and the budget values in effect
confirmed_current_definition.min8_replay_does_not_catch_dom_order_dri: explicitly stated -- Replay walks the frozen selector sequence and will pass even if candidate order (and thus what the shortest path would be today) has changed. Only a fresh Scout run (repeated, per §2.5 'MIN-4 경로 결정성 케이스') can detect DOM non-determinism in dom_order.

pc_engine_audit.target: agent/landing-pc-fixture @ 0c36c95 (merged into this branch via clean git merge, zero conflicts)
pc_engine_audit.finding: 0c36c95 predates the entire MIN-4 area->dom_order pivot (V2-C008 through C012 happened on the docs-only exec branch AFTER P-C's fixture engine was built on an older base). P-C's tie-break implementation used the ORIGINAL pre-C008 scheme: (marked_primary, area_css_px2) with `area_css_px2 or 0.0` NULL coercion -- not even the intermediate quantized-area schemes described in A1's correction history, and no dom_order field existed anywhere in the probe or collector.
locations_with_defect: src/landing_accessibility/engine/l0_probe.js -- primary_action_candidates never emitted a dom_order field
src/landing_accessibility/engine/l0_collector.py rank_primary_action_candidates() -- sort key was (marked*2+visible, area_css_px2 or 0.0), reverse=True
src/landing_accessibility/engine/l1_engine.py Scout._activation_candidates() -- sort key was (marked_primary, area_css_px2 or 0.0), reverse=True -- same defect duplicated in a second place
src/landing_accessibility/engine/l1_engine.py Scout.scout() trail entries (TaskManifest.path) -- did not include dom_order at all, violating the A1 §2.6/§8 freeze-output requirement

fix_applied.l0_probe.js: primary_action_candidates map callback now takes (el, dom_order) and includes `dom_order` in each emitted candidate object -- the value is the 0-based index within the already-document-order, already-visibility-filtered array (querySelectorAll returns tree order; Array.filter preserves relative order, so monotonicity holds).
l0_collector.py: PrimaryActionCandidate dataclass gained a `dom_order: int` field

new shared helper `min4_sort_key(c)` implements the exact authoritative total order (marked_primary desc via 0/1 inversion for ascending sort, dom_order asc, selector asc) -- area_css_px2 is not read by this key at all

new `_dom_order_of(c)` + `Min4ProbeContractError` -- raises instead of silently defaulting when dom_order is missing, matching A2 §1.13's 'NULL not allowed, probe defect not observation gap' semantics
rank_primary_action_candidates() now sorts with min4_sort_key (ascending, no reverse) instead of the old area/viewport-blended score
l1_engine.py: imports and reuses the SAME min4_sort_key from l0_collector.py (not a re-implementation) -- this closes a latent second-source-of-truth risk: before this fix, rank_primary_action_candidates() (storage/SELECTED) and Scout._activation_candidates() (path enumeration) could in principle have used different orders even after a partial fix; sharing one function makes that structurally impossible
Scout._activation_candidates() sort key replaced with min4_sort_key

trail entries (which become TaskManifest.path, i.e. the Freeze output) now include `"dom_order": action.get("dom_order")` alongside step_index/selector/expected_state_id, satisfying A1 §2.6/§8's freeze-output requirement

replay() was NOT modified -- it only reads selector/step_index/expected_state_id from path nodes, so the added dom_order key is inert to Replay by design, matching the authority's explicit statement that MIN-8 Replay does not use or re-derive dom_order
fix_applied.scope_deliberately_excluded: area_css_px2's own NULL-coercion (`or 0.0`) in the STORAGE path (PrimaryActionCandidate.area_css_px2 field, used as the PrimaryActionOcclusion denominator) was left unchanged. A1 §2.6 does say area_css_px2 storage should preserve NULL rather than coercing to 0, but that is a distinct pre-existing defect from a different clause (denominator preservation, A2 규칙 C-2) and was not explicitly named in this reconciliation's scope (dom_order observation/storage, NULL semantics [of dom_order], document-local ordering, Freeze output, Scout repeated determinism). Flagged here as an OPEN_ISSUE for a future pass rather than silently fixed to avoid scope creep and untested type-signature changes to a field several tests assert as a bare float.

test_dom_order_is_stable_across_repeated_collection -- runs L0Collector.collect() twice (independent EvidenceRun instances) against the same fixture, asserts the (selector, dom_order) pairs are byte-identical across both runs
